title: Create: Aeronautics/Ultimate Factory Recipe Fix
description: This datapack fixes a bug in "Create: Ultimate Factory" where the "compat" folder does not work on servers.
body: The **"Create: Ultimate Factory"** mod includes a **compatibility folder** designed to prevent recipe conflicts between **"Create: Ultimate Factory"** and **"Create: Aeronautics"**. While this works correctly in single-player worlds, the folder sometimes **fails to take effect on servers**; this **datapack** is provided **specifically to resolve this bug on servers**.
